- 修正任务相关的 Java 工具依赖检查，减少不必要的 keytool 要求，并改善版本探测失败与未知版本的错误引导。
- 减少已对齐 APK 在签名时的重复整包重写；仍校验布局、内容 CRC、长度和 Native 打包策略，不满足条件时继续原流程。
- 加强异常 ZIP 元数据的复用限制，并在重写结果验证通过后才替换原文件。不改变 Android 支持范围、壳加载方式或加固配置。

- Corrected task-specific Java tool checks to avoid unnecessary keytool requirements and improve guidance for failed or unknown version detection.
- Avoided redundant archive rewriting when signing an already-aligned APK, while retaining layout, content CRC, length and native-packaging checks. Inputs that do not qualify still use the existing rewrite path.
- Tightened reuse checks for abnormal ZIP metadata and validated rewritten output before replacing the input. Android support, runtime loading and protection settings remain unchanged.
